summary: Verified all 3 reported bug fixes: 1) Fuel filtering by industry sector, 2) Admin delete emission, 3) Override UI blank input. All fixes working correctly.

bug_1_fuel_filtering.description: Fuel list is correctly filtered by facility's industry/sector
bug_1_fuel_filtering.evidence: When Manufacturing facility selected, only fuels with industry_sector='Manufacturing' or industry_sectors containing 'Manufacturing' appear. Natural Gas (industry_sector=Manufacturing) and Diesel (industry_sectors=['Energy','Manufacturing','Construction']) both show correctly.

bug_2_admin_delete_emission.description: Admin can delete emission records using trash icon button
bug_2_admin_delete_emission.evidence: Logged in as admin@ghg.com, clicked delete button, confirmation dialog accepted, emission count decreased from 5 to 4, success toast 'Emission record deleted successfully' displayed.

bug_3_override_ui_blank_input.description: Override input shows blank with placeholder 'Enter custom value', original value still visible in Selected Fuel Parameters section
bug_3_override_ui_blank_input.evidence: When 'Override Calorific Value' checkbox is checked, input field is blank with placeholder 'Enter custom value'. The 'Selected Fuel Parameters (from database)' section continues to display the original value (48 MJ/kg).

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Fuel filtering logic in getFuelsForScope (lines 239-261) correctly handles both legacy industry_sector field and new industry_sectors array
GOOD: handleDelete function (lines 884-896) properly implements confirmation dialog and API call
GOOD: Override checkbox onChange handler (lines 1387-1405) clears formData.calorific_value when checked
GOOD: Selected Fuel Parameters section (lines 1299-1325) reads directly from fuelDatabase, not formData, so original values persist
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs have been verified as fixed. Fuel filtering works for both industry_sector and industry_sectors fields. Delete button visible and functional for admin. Override UI correctly clears input and shows placeholder while keeping original value visible in fuel parameters section.
